discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature, highly cited field that pairs a clear theory prediction (Kane-Mele Z2 invariant, 2005) with a decisive experiment (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum well measurements, 2007). It already has Breakthrough, Dirac and Wolf-type recognition. The 2016 topology prize covered only the earlier theory, and the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang line lost Shoucheng Zhang in 2018, so Kane, Mele and Molenkamp form the most natural trio. The 2024 machine-learning prize and the 2025 superconducting-circuit prize make a return to condensed-matter fundamentals plausible.
